# NIST ACVP SLH-DSA-SHA2-192f sigGen (FIPS 205), EXTERNAL pure interface with an EMPTY context: the only two such positive cases for this parameter set, and the form of the record second leg from WIRE_VERSION 8. From usnistgov/ACVP-Server gen-val (SLH-DSA-sigGen-FIPS205, internalProjection, vsId 53). Fields: tcId|expect|reason|sk|pk|message|signature (hex). sk is given only on the deterministic case: the v8 leg signs deterministically (opt_rand = PK.seed), so tc25 pins signing byte for byte.
